subject: Engelska 6
title: Grammar: passive voice and reported speech
sourceSummary: Aktiv och passiv form i olika tempus, samt hur man gör om direkt tal till indirekt tal (reported speech) med korrekt tempusbackning.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
questions.opener: Leta efter formen "be" + perfekt particip — det är kännetecknet.
choices: The committee announced the results yesterday.
The results were announced by the committee yesterday.
The committee will announce the results soon.
The committee is announcing the results now.
questions.explanation: I passiv voice blir den som drabbas av handlingen ("the results") subjekt, och verbet står i "be" + perfekt particip: "were announced". De andra alternativen har subjektet som utför handlingen, alltså aktiv form.

questions.prompt: Rewrite in the passive: "Millions of people watch this show every week."
questions.opener: Vem eller vad blir det som "drabbas" av handlingen? Det ska bli den nya meningens subjekt.
choices: This show is watched by millions of people every week.
This show was watched by millions of people every week.
This show watches millions of people every week.
Millions of people are watched by this show every week.
questions.explanation: Objektet "this show" blir subjekt, och eftersom huvudsatsen står i presens blir passivformen "is watched". Alternativ 4 kastar om vem som utför och vem som utsätts för handlingen, vilket ändrar betydelsen helt.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: "The results ___ yet." (announce)
questions.opener: Present perfect passive byggs med have/has been + perfekt particip.
choices: haven't announced
haven't been announced
aren't announced
weren't been announced
questions.explanation: Present perfect passive: have/has (not) been + particip — "haven't been announced". "haven't announced" saknar "been" och blir aktiv form med fel betydelse (den kräver ett objekt).

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: "A decision ___ by Friday." (make)
questions.opener: Future passive: will be + perfekt particip.
choices: will make
is made
will be made
will have make
questions.explanation: Future passive bildas med "will be" + particip: "will be made". "will make" är aktiv form och kräver ett objekt (vem som fattar beslutet), vilket saknas här.

questions.prompt: Report this statement: "I am tired," she said.
questions.opener: Tempus flyttas ofta ett steg bakåt (backshift) när det inledande verbet står i preteritum.
choices: She said she is tired.
She said she was tired.
She said I was tired.
She says she was tired.
questions.explanation: "am" backshiftas till "was", och "I" byts till "she" eftersom det är hon som talar om sig själv. Att behålla presens ("is") eller "I" är de vanligaste felen vid reported speech.

questions.prompt: Report this question: "Where do you live?" he asked.
questions.opener: I indirekta frågor blir ordföljden som i ett vanligt påstående — ingen hjälpverb-inversion och inget frågetecken.
choices: He asked where do I live.
He asked where did I live.
He asked where I live.
He asked where I lived.
questions.explanation: Indirekta frågor tappar hjälpverbet "do/did" och får rak ordföljd (subjekt före verb), och tempus backshiftas: "where I lived". "where do/did I live" behåller felaktigt frågeordföljden.

questions.prompt: Find and correct the three errors: "The teacher told to us turn off our phones, and she said that we not must talk during the test."
questions.opener: Titta på tre saker: prepositionen efter "told", verbformen efter objektet, och var "not" ska stå ihop med "must".
questions.answer: The teacher told us to turn off our phones, and she said that we must not talk during the test.
steps: "told to us" → "told us": verbet "tell" följs direkt av objektet, utan preposition ("tell someone to do something").
"us turn off" → "us to turn off": reported command kräver infinitiv med "to" efter objektet.
"we not must talk" → "we must not talk": nekande modala verb bildas med "must not", aldrig "not must".
Sammanfattning: reported commands byggs med tell/ask + objekt + infinitiv med "to", t.ex. "told us to turn off", "asked us not to talk".

questions.prompt: Summarize how to form the passive in different tenses.
questions.opener: Samma mönster i alla tempus — bara hjälpverbet "be" ändras.
questions.answer: Present simple: am/is/are + particip — "The letter is sent." · Past simple: was/were + particip — "The letter was sent." · Present perfect: have/has been + particip — "The letter has been sent." · Future: will be + particip — "The letter will be sent." · Modal: modal + be + particip — "The letter must be sent." · Regel: bara transitiva verb (verb som tar objekt) kan bli passiva, och "by + agent" läggs bara till när det är viktigt vem som utförde handlingen.

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly completes the passive transformation: "The chef prepared the meal." → "The meal ___ by the chef."
questions.opener: Vilket tempus hade den aktiva meningen, och vilken particip-form matchar det i passiv?
choices: was prepared
is prepared
prepared
has prepare
questions.explanation: Den aktiva meningen står i preteritum ("prepared"), så passivformen blir past simple passive: "was prepared". De andra alternativen har fel tempus eller felaktig verbform.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: "The bridge ___ in 1889." (build)
questions.opener: Tidsangivelsen 1889 visar att det är dåtid — vilken passivform hör ihop med past simple?
choices: was built
was build
has built
is building
questions.explanation: Tidsangivelsen 1889 anger dåtid, så rätt passivform är past simple passive: "was built". "was build" har fel particip, och de andra alternativen har fel tempus eller form.

questions.prompt: Report this statement: "We have finished the project," they said.
questions.opener: Present perfect i direkt tal backshiftas till past perfect i reported speech.
choices: They said they had finished the project.
They said they have finished the project.
They said we have finished the project.
They said they finished the project since long.
questions.explanation: Present perfect ("have finished") backshiftas till past perfect ("had finished") i reported speech, och "we" byts till "they" eftersom det är de som talar om sig själva.

questions.prompt: Report this question: "Have you ever been to Paris?" she asked me.
questions.opener: Ja/nej-frågor i reported speech inleds med "if" eller "whether", och ordföljden blir rak.
choices: She asked me if I had ever been to Paris.
She asked me have I ever been to Paris.
She asked me if I have ever been to Paris.
She asked me if had I ever been to Paris.
questions.explanation: Ja/nej-frågor i reported speech inleds med "if" eller "whether" och får rak ordföljd, och tempus backshiftas: "if I had ever been". De andra alternativen behåller felaktigt frågeordföljden eller presens.

questions.prompt: Report this command: "Don't touch that," the guide told the tourists.
questions.opener: Negativa uppmaningar i reported speech: var placeras "not" i förhållande till "to"?
choices: The guide told the tourists not to touch that.
The guide told the tourists to not touch that.
The guide told the tourists don't touch that.
The guide told to the tourists not touch that.
questions.explanation: Negativa uppmaningar i reported speech bildas med "not" + infinitiv med "to": "told them not to touch". Att placera "not" efter "to" eller utelämna "to" blir fel.

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses the passive correctly to emphasize the agent?
questions.opener: "by + agent" läggs till när det är relevant vem som utförde handlingen.
choices: The novel was written by an unknown author in the 1800s.
The novel wrote by an unknown author.
An unknown author was written the novel.
The novel has write by an unknown author.
questions.explanation: "by + agent" läggs till efter passivformen när det är relevant vem som utförde handlingen: "was written by an unknown author". De andra alternativen har felaktiga verbformer.

questions.prompt: Why might a writer choose the passive voice instead of the active voice in a sentence like "Mistakes were made"?
questions.opener: Tänk på vad som saknas i meningen "Mistakes were made" jämfört med "I made mistakes".
choices: To avoid stating who is responsible for the action
Because passive voice is always grammatically required
Because the sentence has no verb in active form
Because passive voice is shorter than active voice
questions.explanation: Passiv röst används ofta just för att undvika att peka ut vem som är ansvarig för handlingen, som i "Mistakes were made" där ingen nämns som gjorde felen. Det är ett stilistiskt val, inte ett grammatiskt krav.
